summary.name: Objective-C to Swift Converter
summary.one_liner: An offline Objective-C to Swift code converter, listed as Swiftify with Xcode and Finder extensions.
use_cases: migrate legacy iOS apps to Swift
summary.what_it_does: The page presents an Objective-C to Swift converter described as an offline, enterprise-oriented tool. The listing says it is Swiftify, offering Objective-C to Swift code conversion along with Xcode and Finder extensions. The page body is mostly an Objective-C code sample (an ARKit view controller) with a contributing call-to-action, so few concrete feature details are given. Pricing and detailed capabilities are not stated in the page text.
notable: Offline converter, per the meta description
Xcode and Finder extensions, per the awesome-mac listing
Example page content is an Objective-C ARKit sample
caveats: Pricing and licensing are not stated on the page
Page text is mostly a code sample with little product detail
